chapters.label: Live: EURO 2026
chapters.text: The 2026 Futsal EURO quarter-final, in Riga. France play Ukraine. It is one all after forty minutes. In extra time, captain Mouhoudine scores: one, two, three goals! France win four two.

chapters.label: How he wins the ball
chapters.text: Mouhoudine plays at the back. This is how he wins the ball: he watches the pass. It looks past him, but he stretches his long leg, pokes it away and attacks!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Slow motion now. Read the pass, stretch that long leg, poke it away, go!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: use your long legs to reach passes, and win the ball back!
